text: Applied whitespace/comment wrapping to 48 R files and verified every executable AST stayed identical for that formatting step. Test formatting AST review found only added control-flow/function braces in nine files. CLI-interpolated variables and deliberate parent-scope traversal/reader counters retain narrow documented lint annotations; actual unused dimensions/counts removed. Qualification tests now import frozen gate helpers into an explicit environment without changing frozen thresholds. Targeted parcel-data, subcortical and gate regressions pass after correcting cleanup bindings. Project lint rerun uses lint_package with explicit package scope.
